name: az_constant
description: Continuous AZ matrix training with measurable checkpoints, superseding az_matrix. Uses the 2026-07-29 gate rework: self-play generates with the CANDIDATE line (resolve_source prefers gen__azv* snapshots, so kept-incumbent stretches no longer freeze the data distribution), gates run every 3 slots (gate_every - the candidate accumulates 3 cycles of training per eval and the ~1h gate cost is paid 1/3 as often), and the per-deck floor veto compares candidate vs incumbent on LIKE pairings (a lopsided deck matchup the incumbent also loses no longer reads as collapse). Structure: a fresh doomsday expert dose, then a TRUE azraw:gen reference baseline (NOTE: the 2026-07-28 22:16 baseline_report block was accidentally the PPO gen - the TUI round-trip dropped the model field - so do NOT diff against it), then alternating ~20h az-league blocks (6 matrix slots each, distinct seed bases so matchup schedules differ across blocks) and azraw:gen round-robin baselines, ending in an INDEFINITE block (rotations 0, Ctrl-C to stop). Every az-league block keeps the whole-roster matrix focus, the per-slot 16-match wubg_doomsday expert dose, and 256-sim bo3 self-play. Measure progress by diffing the wubg_doomsday pilot rows across the appended baseline_report.log blocks (phases 2/4/6, plus by hand after stopping phase 7: train.py baseline azraw:gen --all --games 50). Interrupt anywhere and continue with curriculum --plan az_constant --resume; an interrupted az-league block resumes mid-block via its own sidecar. Promote bar stays 0.55 aggregate - with 3 cycles per gate and the fairer floor this is attainable; lower via a promote_threshold override if promotions still stall.
